defect_observations.observation: Locator misattribution: the regimes 'singular curvature, boundary modes and increasing dimension' are cited to K&R Sec. 4.1.3, which does not discuss them; boundary modes are at Sec. 4.1.2 (Hsiao 1994, p. 778) and many degrees of freedom at Sec. 4.4 (p. 781). Only the blockwise/hierarchical point and the n rule are in Sec. 4.1.3.

The remark 'both prior-log terms have coefficient two' corrects the source's printed eq. (6) (p. 778, coefficient one on log pi(beta^,psi^|H1) - log pi(beta*|H0)) without naming the source display or its printed coefficient; a reader checking (6) meets an unexplained conflict.

Source eq. (9) is not named; the section never says the source states (S - log B12)/log B12 -> 0 without the divergence premise that thm:p15-bic-leading-order adds. Jeffreys's S + c (Cauchy-prior constant, p. 779) is not mentioned anywhere in the chapter.

Relative-error consequences use the MLE Laplace hypotheses that the lemma does not state; annex lines 106-109 rely on 'the already proved 1+O(n^-1) approximation'. Adding 'under the MLE hypotheses of thm:p15-laplace-mode-variants' to the lemma would close it.

Gloss 'Local alternatives means that psi - psi_0 = O(n^-1/2)' cited to Sec. 5.2 p. 782; the source's assumption there is on the estimate, psi^ - psi_0 = O(n^-1/2). The theorem's premise 2 (line 504) correctly uses psi^_n, so this is a gloss imprecision only.

Minor: 'A proposal improving concentration can worsen tail behavior' carries \cite[Sec.~4.2]; Sec. 4.2 (p. 779) says only that importance sampling 'can' improve precision. The tail claim is the handbook's own, exhibited by thm:p15-mc-evidence-boundaries item 3; the citation reads as locating the qualified source claim. Not counted against C008.
